The '''Kav-Dann''' was a type of [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. The [[Kav-Dann power armor]], a type of [[Armor/Legends|body armor]] created by [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] on Nubia, was named after the Kav-Dann.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kav-Dann was mentioned in ''[[Keeping the Peace]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'',<ref name="Keeping the Peace" /> released in [[2015]].<ref name="Now Is Your Chance">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/12/17/now-is-your-chance|text=Now Is Your Chance}}</ref>
